attchmntText: Filatex India Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Filatex India Limited filed an investor presentation for Q2 and H1 FY27 with the National Stock Exchange on 13th November 2026. The company reported standalone revenue of Rs. 1,304.19 crore for Q2 FY27, representing 21% year-on-year growth. EBITDA stood at Rs. 91.03 crore with a margin of 6.98%. Profit after tax was Rs. 53.48 crore, showing 12% year-on-year growth. For H1 FY27, revenue reached Rs. 2,449.49 crore and PAT was Rs. 102.62 crore. The presentation outlined five capital expenditure projects totaling Rs. 690 crore. These include the ECOSIS textile-to-textile recycling plant with a capacity of 27,000 tonnes per annum and a PFY expansion adding 55,000 tonnes per annum. The company highlighted progress in renewable energy transition and steam distribution utility monetization.

attchmntText: Filatex India Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Filatex India Limited approved standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board meeting was held on November 13, 2026. Standalone revenue from operations was Rs. 1,304.19 Crores for the quarter and Rs. 2,449.49 Crores for the half year. Standalone net profit after tax was Rs. 53.48 Crores for the quarter and Rs. 102.62 Crores for the half year. Earnings per share were Rs. 1.20 for the quarter and Rs. 2.31 for the half year. The company made an additional investment of Rs. 20.00 Crores in its wholly owned subsidiary, Ecosis Limited. The statutory auditors expressed an unmodified report on the results.

attchmntText: Filatex India Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet Earnings Conference call to be held on Monday, 16th November, 2026 at 4.00 P.M. (1ST) to discuss the Q2 & H1FY27 Result
voiceSummary: Filatex India Limited has scheduled an earnings conference call for analysts and investors on Monday 16th November 2026 at 4.00 P.M. IST. The call will discuss the Q2 and H1FY27 results. Participants will include Mr. Madhu Sudhan Bhageria, Chairman and Managing Director, Mr. Ashok Chauhan, Chief Visionary Officer, Mr. Nitin Agarwal, Chief Financial Officer, and Mr. Vedansh Bhageria, Director of Ecosis Limited. The company has enclosed an invitation with telephone numbers and contact details for the event. Dial-in numbers are +91 22 6280 1511 and +91 22 7115 8849. Pre-registration is recommended to avoid wait time. For further information, investors may contact Gulshan Singh at Sunidhi Securities or Janhavi Kankriya at Branding Edge. This intimation is filed pursuant to Regulation 30(6) of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: Filatex India Limited has informed the Exchange about acquisition of 1,30,00,000 Equity Shares of Ecosis Limited (formerly known as Texfil Private Limited), Wholly Owned Subsidiary Company.
voiceSummary: Filatex India Limited acquired 1,30,00,000 equity shares of its wholly owned subsidiary, Ecosis Limited, on 7th November, 2026. The shares have a face value of Rs. 1 each and were purchased at Rs. 10 per share. The total investment amounts to Rs. 13.00 crore. This brings the cumulative investment in Ecosis to approximately Rs. 98 crores. The funds will finance the ongoing Polyester Textiles Recycling Project, repay existing loans from Filatex, and meet working capital requirements. The transaction is classified as a related party transaction conducted on an arm's length basis. No promoter or group company holds an interest in this deal. No governmental or regulatory approval is required.
